name: Quiz — question loads with 4 choices and feedback shown after answer

planSteps.description: A 'Quiz' badge is visible in the header
Exactly 4 choice buttons labeled A, B, C, D are visible
Click the first choice button (choice A, id='choice-0')
One choice button turns green (correct answer highlighted) and another turns red if the answer is wrong, OR the clicked button turns green if correct
An explanation text appears below the choices after selecting an answer
A 'ข้อถัดไป' next button is visible after selecting an answer
